sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: sEvakajana sama varadha sEthAvara sukhakaradha - rAmalOka ghana sharadha ramya kEshavaradha
similar to anupallavi - bhoovalayAdhipa varadhabhoopa gama jithadhviradha - bhava sakalagadha hara dhayA vilAsa ruchira radha

sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: kAnana virachitha charaNa kanjathAmrathara charaNa - soona hAra shubha karaNa soorya kulAbharaNa
similar to anupallavi - dhAnava kula madha haraNa dheena dheena jana sharaNa - mouni kalpitha smaraNa maananeeya mahitharaNa

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: pAlitha kaushika savana padhmanAbha marudhavana - shailavairikRtha navana shAntha sAgara vana
similar to anupallavi - neelagAthra guNa bhavana neethi heena ghana pavana - sAla bhEdha kRtha javana sarOjAkshabRtha bhuvana
